kv.memory.broadside-just-completed-a-maj: Broadside just completed a major codereview and pentest review/fix cycle. Its implementations should be treated as the security-hardened reference when there's a conflict between projects.
kv.memory.canonical-schema-decisions-use: Canonical schema decisions: users+personas split (gaja model), INTEGER Unix seconds for timestamps, TEXT UUIDs in SQLite / native UUID in Postgres, remote_accounts FK for remote actors (not inline in followers).
kv.memory.no-crates-io-publishing-yet-us: No crates.io publishing yet. Use path deps for local dev and git deps (github.com/MarkAtwood/fedistract) for CI/sharing. Publish to crates.io only when Mark says he's ready.
kv.memory.no-running-gaja-instances-gaja: No running gaja instances - gaja can use fieldwork canonical schema directly without migration. Only smallhold and broadside need DB migrators.
